description: S6 exploration pass — scale-out 1 -> 2 -> 3 workers, one route with replicas = workers, 48 partitions, 1 KB, maxInFlight 5000 (so each replica is CPU-bound, not in-flight-bound). Two CPU layouts: "fair" splits the same 6 cores 0-5 across the workers (0-5 | 0-2,3-5 | 0-1,2-3,4-5): total CPU constant, shows the cost of splitting; "c2" gives every worker its own 2 cores (0-1 | 0-1,2-3 | = fair-w3): CPU grows with workers, shows scaling. 1-min steps (20 s warm-up); s6-confirm re-checks the knees with 5-min steps. Partition ownership is snapshotted into results/s6-explore/spread-<case>.txt. Local only (workers.sh).
